title: Stable quadratic polynomials over $\mathbb{Q}(i)$
summary: We study iterates of a quadratic $f= x^2+1/c\in K[x]$. If the number of factors of $f^n:=f\circ f \circ ... \circ f$ is bounded by a constant independent of $n$, then $f$ is said to be \emph{eventually stable}. This paper is an extension to $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of the paper \cite{evstb}, which considered $f$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. The conjecture "if $f^2$ is irreducible, then $f^n$ is irreducible for all $n$" extends to $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, but due to the lack of a linear ordering on $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, an auxiliary function is involved in a specific $n$ to check.
